summary: Verified email/password authentication, organizations, invitations and tenant isolation; confirm Obra design reference
independenceRationale: Identity and tenant boundaries require independent security/architecture and QA review.
acceptance: Real registration, email verification, login, recovery and signout.
One organization/membership source with owner/admin/analyst/viewer roles.
Protected context endpoint rejects unauthenticated and cross-company access.
Invitation ownership/expiry and role escalation protections are tested.
Auth UI is accessible, functional and truthful about pending business features.
semanticRouting: Product acceptance and security architecture before auth code; UX/design before UI. No logistics financial behavior, invoice extraction or external business connectors change. Local transactional email is auth infrastructure, not business mailbox integration.
limitations: Exact Obra Figma node inspection is unavailable; no pixel fidelity claim.
Corporate SSO, social providers and real customer data processing remain outside this phase.
Real PostgreSQL runtime acceptance pending CI; local executor cannot run PostgreSQL as a nonroot user.
MFA, known reverse proxy configuration and ownership transfer are rollout gates, not claimed delivered.
